scope: Proposition 2.1 (Fixed-word transfer) of the manuscript “QAOA attains the SK ground-state energy in the thermodynamic-first limit” (preprints/QAOA-attains-the-SK-ground-state-energy-in-the-thermodynamic-first-limit-September-25-2026/QAOA-attains-the-SK-ground-state-energy-in-the-thermodynamic-first-limit-September-25-2026.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 281 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 4d07ebe181b03157), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 6. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. The manuscript presents this as a result of other work, which it uses; the attribution names that work in the manuscript's own words. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let W be an ordinary QAOA word, and apply the same word to the (D + 1)-regular tree with cost CD = D−1/2 P {i,j}∈E ZiZj, with each unordered edge counted once. Its expectation at an edge is defined by restricting to the finite light cone of that edge. Then vW = lim D→∞ √ D 2 ⟨WDΩ|ZiZj|WDΩ⟩. (2.1) Here vW is the disorder-averaged thermodynamic SK energy per vertex, with the normalization in the introduction. Both limits exist for every fixed word and every fixed choice of its angles.
